dedupe_keys.name: position du trait de cote du littoral sableux aquitain en 2017

description: Position du trait de côte du littoral sableux aquitain en 2017 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Coastline 2017 from Pointe du Verdon to Cap Saint Martin (sandy coast ex-Aquitaine). The coastline on the sandy coast corresponds to the foot of a dune. This rib trait was determined by photo-interpretation of orthophotography 2017 (©IGN, OCA 2017), supported by LiDAR data acquired synchronously during orthophotography. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Position of the Aquitaine sandy coastline in 2017" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Trait de côte, Gironde, Côte sableuse, 2017, Pyrénées-Atlantiques, Landes. The listing shows 2018-05-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
